parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Class widths: 20, 10, 10, 5, 20. Frequency densities: 0.8, 3.2, 7.6, 12.8, 0.6. M1 for at least four frequency densities calculated as $f/\text{class width}$, e.g. $16/20$; condone $f/(\text{class width}\pm0.5)$ if unsimplified; accept unsimplified values, or values read from a graph using their scale no lower than $1\text{ cm}=\text{frequency density }2$. A1 for all bar heights correct on the graph, not FT, using their suitable linear scale with at least three values indicated and no lower than $1\text{ cm}=\text{frequency density }2$. B1 for bar ends at 150, 160, 170, 175 and 195; five bars drawn with a horizontal linear scale no lower than $1\text{ cm}=10\text{ cm}$, with at least three values indicated and $130\le\text{horizontal scale}\le195$. B1 for axes labelled frequency density (fd), height ($h$) and cm, OE, or an appropriate title; axes may be reversed. Total 4.

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Lower-quartile class: $160\le h<170$; upper-quartile class: $170\le h<175$; $175-160=15$. M1 for $170\le h_{UQ}<175$ minus $160\le h_{LQ}<170$, with the UQ and LQ classes seen. A1 for $175-160=15$. If M0 is scored, SC B1 for $175-160=15$. Total 2.
